open: In the name of Allah. Assalamu alaikum, my dears. Come closer, tonight’s story is very beautiful.
s1a: Shh. Noah, Ilyas. Imagine mysterious guests knocking at a door. They look like ordinary men, but they are something completely different.
s1c: I’ll tell you in a moment. Get warm and cosy… Tonight I’ll tell you about the Prophet Lut, peace be upon him. Do you remember? Lut is the one who believed in Ibrahim and went with him to the blessed land.
s2a: Allah sent Lut to a town whose people did very bad things that Allah has forbidden: they robbed people on the roads, and did evil in their gatherings. And Lut told them they were doing a shameful deed that no one had done before them.
s2b: Lut said to them: Fear Allah and obey me. I do not ask you for any payment for this.
s2c: And did they listen to him?
s2d: No. Instead they said: Throw the family of Lut out of your town; they are people who want to stay pure!
s3a: One day, guests came to Ibrahim. They said: Peace! He said: Peace! And soon he brought them a roasted calf.
s3b: When he saw that their hands did not reach for the food, he found it strange, and he felt a little afraid of them.
s3c: They said: Do not be afraid. And they gave his wife the good news of Ishaq.
s3d: Angels! That’s why they didn’t eat!
s3e: That’s right, my dear. Then they said they had been sent to the people of Lut. Ibrahim said: But Lut is there! They said: We know best who is there. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife.
s4a: Then the angels came to Lut. He was worried because of them and felt very uneasy, and he said: This is a hard day, a very hard day.
s4b: His people came rushing to him. Lut said to them: Fear Allah and do not shame me in front of my guests. Is there not one sensible man among you?
s4c: And what did the guests do?
s4d: The angels said: “O Lut, indeed we are messengers of your Lord; they will never reach you. So set out with your family during a portion of the night and let not any among you look back – except your wife; indeed, she will be struck by that which strikes them. Indeed, their appointment is the morning. Is not the morning near?”
s5a: So Lut and his family left at night, as they had been commanded – except his wife.
s5b: And when morning came, what Allah had announced happened: Allah turned the town upside down and rained stones upon it. Lut’s wife stayed with them, because she did not believe.
s5d: Yes, my dear. Lut had warned them, but they did not want to listen. And Allah saved Lut and those who believed with him.
s6a: Allah says about Lut: “And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.” He spoke the truth, and he protected his guests, as a generous host does.
s7a: They’ve fallen asleep… Always listen to what is good, even if others laugh. Honour your guests. And choose good friends who bring you closer to Allah, for every person is responsible for their own deeds.
s7b: And next time, I’ll tell you about Ismail… and about a spring in the middle of the desert that still flows today. And you, watching us right now: if you liked the story, ask your parents to subscribe to our channel, so you don’t miss the next story.
close: And you, dear fathers and mothers: subscribe to our channel, and share these stories with the people you love, so that together we pass on the beautiful message of Islam to our children.
final: Good night, my dears. I entrust you to Allah, with whom nothing entrusted is ever lost.
